props.name: cancelOnBlur
props.comment: Cancel on a focus move out of the editor; when false, save instead. Default `true`.

props.name: children
props.comment: What to show while reading and saving. Default `<TextField source={source} />`.

props.name: editor
props.comment:
What to edit with, inside the form. Default
`<TextInput source={source} label={false} helperText={false} autoFocus />`.

props.name: notifyOnSuccess
props.comment: Notify `chelone.notification.updated` on success. Undoable mode always notifies, with Undo. Default `false`.

props.name: onError
props.comment: Runs with the failure after a rejected update.

props.name: onSuccess
props.comment: Runs with the saved record after a successful update.

props.name: showButtons
props.comment: Show Save and Cancel buttons beside the input. Default `false`.

props.name: source
props.comment:
The field to show and edit. Required unless both `children` and `editor`
are given.
